likely_causes: Inlet hose is kinked
Water faucet is turned off
Water faucet is clogged or calcified
Filters in the water connection of the supply or AquaStop hose are blocked
repair_steps: Install the inlet hose without kinks.
Turn on the faucet.
Turn on the faucet. The flow rate must be at least 10 l/min when the water supply is open.
Switch off the appliance.
Pull out the power cord plug.
Turn off the water faucet.
Unscrew the water connection.
Remove the filter from the supply hose.
Clean the filter.
Reinsert the filter in the supply hose.
Screw the water connection back on.
Check the water connection for leaks.
Restore the power supply.
Switch the appliance on.

meaning: Not an appliance error. The drain pump cover is loose or a foreign object is blocking the pump.
likely_causes: The drain pump cover is loose
A foreign object is blocking the pump
repair_steps: Secure the cover of the drain pump so it clicks into place or clean the drain pump.

likely_causes: Garbage disposal is still plugged
The drain hose is kinked
The drain pump cover is loose
A foreign object is blocking the pump
High loop is missing
Debris flushed back into drain hose and blocked it
repair_steps: Check that the garbage disposal plug is removed and that the drain hose is not kinked.
Secure the cover of the drain pump so it clicks into place or clean the drain pump.
Be sure there is a high loop in the drain hose and that no debris has flushed back into the hose.

Put the oven back into operation

If the function error code repeats, call for service
